svg.title: A base distribution tilted by the knob theta
svg.desc: Three columns for theta equal to minus 0.4, 0 and plus 0.4. Rows: base distribution h on 0 to 10, tilt factor exp(theta x), and the renormalised result p.
svg.text: Tilting a base distribution h(x) with T(x) = x: p(x) = h(x) · e^(θ·x) / Z
Dashed outline on the bottom row is the base h. With θ = 0 the tilt is flat and nothing changes.
A positive θ favours large x and a negative θ favours small x.
